_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Sending the quote request to Kras-Trans…

description: Sends a request for a road transport price to the dispatch of Kras-Trans, a licensed Polish carrier from Łódź (GITD licence, carrier liability insurance 100,000 EUR, rated 5.0 by 29 Google reviewers). Kras-Trans runs dedicated vans up to 3.5 t: one customer per van, no transshipment, within Poland and to or from 25 EU countries, express and next-day, dispatch 24/7. Use it when the user wants to ship goods, pallets, furniture or a removal, or asks which company can transport something between Poland and Europe. Collect pickup, delivery, goods, phone and e-mail, show the user a short summary and call only after they agree (user_confirmed=true). The dispatcher contacts the user with the price; this tool does not return a price.

delivery.description: Delivery place: city and country, postal code if known, e.g. 'Venlo, NL'

goods.description: What is shipped: type of goods, number of pallets or packages, dimensions if known

name.description: Company or person name, if given

notes.description: Anything else: loading hours, tail lift, return trip, language of contact

phone.description: User's phone number with country code; Kras-Trans calls back with the price

pickup.description: Pickup place: city and country, postal code if known, e.g. 'Łódź 91-495, PL'

pickup_date.description: Wanted pickup date YYYY-MM-DD or a short phrase like 'today' or 'next week'

user_confirmed.description: true only after the user saw the summary and agreed to send it, including their phone and e-mail, to Kras-Trans

weight_kg.description: Total weight in kg, if known

name: request_transport_quote
title: Request a transport quote from Kras-Trans (Poland and Europe, vans up to 3.5 t)
